content: When diagnosing diabetes, it is important to consider the recommendations of the American Diabetes Association (ADA) regarding appropriate screening methods. The A1C test, fasting plasma glucose (FPG) test, and 2-hour plasma glucose (2-h PG) test each provide unique insights into different aspects of glucose metabolism. However, the results of these tests can vary depending on the characteristics of the population being tested as well as individual patient factors. The ADA emphasizes that the use of different diagnostic thresholds may lead to the identification of separate groups of individuals at risk for diabetes or its complications.
